purpose: Independent atmospheric vertical-smoke diagnostic for the Taylor Ann Arbor twilight night. This diagnostic must not read Taylor SQM observations or MYSTIC residuals and must not be used for post-result aerosol fitting.

model.name: NOAA HRRR v4 inline smoke
model.archive: NOAA HRRR public AWS Open Data archive
model.cycle_policy: Use the f00 field from the hourly cycle whose analysis/valid time equals each frozen valid time.
model.grid_role: Nearest native HRRR grid point to the frozen site; preserve the actual selected grid latitude/longitude and distance.
fields_to_preserve_if_available: MASSDEN fire-smoke mass density on model/hybrid or pressure levels

interpretation_boundary.primary_question: Was the modeled smoke burden near Ann Arbor predominantly near-surface or elevated during the observation hour?
